instruction: Generate a DNSSEC key using ldns-keygen
output:
Kexample.com.+008+12345

Key size: 1024 bits

Use ldns-keygen -a RSASHA1_NSEC3 for NSEC3-capable keys.

instruction: Generate an ECDSA key using ldns-keygen
output:
Kexample.com.+013+54321

Key generated.
Algorithm: ECDSAP256SHA256 (13)
Key size: 256 bits

ldns-keygen supports multiple DNSSEC algorithms.

instruction: Look up MX records with drill
